# Data layer

**No database, ORM or server-side store.** The database-analysis families do not apply. The only persistent state is the browser save described below. [HIGH]

## Save store (IndexedDB)

| Item | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Database | `lowbridge-first-slice` | `src/persistence.ts:4-11` |
| Slots | `current` and `backup`; load falls back to the backup and reports "Recovered" | `src/persistence.ts:280-297`, `src/main.ts:43` |
| Writer | Single writer: one tab holds the Web Lock; writes are chained promises | `src/main.ts:160-161`, `src/main.ts:98` |
| Format | `lowbridge-save` v6, a sparse delta keyed by record id; derived fields are never stored | `src/persistence.ts:27-47`, `src/persistence.ts:80-107` |
| Old versions | Refused by name with an export hint | `src/persistence.ts:155-160` |
| Fight in progress | Saved as `fight` and resumed from the same exchange | `src/persistence.ts:105`, `src/persistence.ts:210` |
| Import/export | JSON file of at most 5 MB, validated by the same `decodeSave` | `src/main.ts:58`, `src/main.ts:124-125` |

## Load-time rules
- Items for ids that content no longer has are dropped (`src/persistence.ts:172-173`). Unknown ids in `attuned`, `active`, `waiting` and a saved `fight` refuse the save (`src/persistence.ts:113`, `src/persistence.ts:199`, `src/persistence.ts:219-223`). See `issues.md`. [HIGH]
- The engine is built first, so validation sees today's derived caps; the bank is clamped to the derived cap (`src/persistence.ts:235-238`). [HIGH]
- The active task must have paid its entry, and every objective must still be available (`src/persistence.ts:239-247`). [HIGH]

## Preferences (localStorage)
`lowbridge.ui.groups`, `lowbridge.ui.seenDiscovery` and `lowbridge.ui.seenCompletion` hold presentation state only; failures are ignored (`src/ui.ts:46`, `src/ui.ts:94-95`, `src/ui.ts:471`). [HIGH]
